---
title: "How to contribute"
---

The simplest route is the [plain-language suggestion page](contributions/index.qmd). Direct edits are also welcome through pull requests.

## What makes a useful contribution

Describe the reader’s situation, the decision or failure mode, where the change belongs, the proposed improvement and any supporting evidence. Prefer official, primary and peer-reviewed sources. State jurisdiction, limitations and review date for time-sensitive guidance.

## Privacy and licensing

Do not contribute confidential, identifiable, restricted or security-sensitive material. Prose and reusable non-code content are accepted under CC BY 4.0; code, configuration and scripts are accepted under MIT. Contributors may request named, organisational, pseudonymous or no public credit.

## Editorial outcomes

The founding editor may accept, merge, defer, request evidence, classify as a local adaptation, or decline a suggestion. Decisions should be explained and connected to the community-request and editorial records.
